title: The Balanced Portfolio
desc: Spread your funds between checking, savings, and a brokerage.
to-teach: Diversify funds across multiple account types.
hints: A resilient financial architecture uses checking for operations, savings for safety, and brokerage for growth.
Open a brokerage account and split your monthly surplus: $300 to Savings and $400 to Brokerage.

client.name: Casey
client.description: Casey wants a balanced three-account structure covering bills, cash safety, and long-term asset growth.
client.prompt: I want to divide my monthly cash flow across bills, emergency cash, and long-term investing. How should I set this up?
